figurative_meaning_en: To be ready or inclined to set out or leave
example_sentences_in_bangla: বাড়ি ফিরতে পা বাড়ানোর আগেই খবর পেল।
example_sentences_in_english: He has already stepped forward to leave.
Before taking a step towards home, he got the news.
note: This idiom reflects everyday Bengali expressions of intent and action in movement.
